items.question: What claim about the scope of suffering is at stake in stating how many womb-diagrams contain tormented beings?
premises: A count of eighty-four thousand is specified.
Those beings are located in womb-diagrams.
The beings in those locations are tormented.
items.inference: Torment extends to beings present within eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams.
uncertainties: Whether the count is literal or figurative remains unclear.
items.plain_english: In eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams, beings are tormented.
